about: Licensed-audio pilot (2026-10-10): every source family considered from DGE-training-sound-discovery.zip, with the decision made for this pilot. Accepted families are the only ones build_manifest.py reads audio from.

karoryfer-big-little-bass.creator: Karoryfer Samples (Washburn AB95 hollowbody bass)
karoryfer-big-little-bass.license_evidence: readme.txt at the pinned commit: 'Royalty-free for all commercial and non-commercial use. CC-0 license.'; https://shop.karoryfer.com/pages/free-samples
karoryfer-big-little-bass.family_note: One instrument, one session: 52 pitches x 2 dynamics x 5 round robins. All files of one pitch stay in one fold.

kenney.creator: Kenney (kenney.nl)
kenney.license_evidence: License.txt inside both archives: 'License: (Creative Commons Zero, CC0)'
kenney.family_note: Both packs are one creator, so they form one family. Sub-groups are the name stems (impactWood, laserSmall, ...), which keep a sound's five variations together.

rubberduck.creator: rubberduck (OpenGameArt)
rubberduck.license_evidence: OpenGameArt pages list CC0 as the only licence; the 50-sound pack says the patches were made from scratch in LMMS/ZynAddSubFX (no factory presets). The .xpf patch files were not executed.
rubberduck.family_note: Both packs are one creator, so they form one family.

not_used.reason: Already being consumed by tagger run 7 (scripts/audio-model/prepare-vcsl.py on claude/raise-tag-accuracy-6ifnkl-run7), which holds out whole VCSL folders as its test set. Not new to DGE; reusing it here would blur run 7's held-out test.

CC0 and useful, but VCSL incorporates VSCO recordings, so it is the same recording family as run 7's VCSL training and held-out folders. Needs a recording-level VCSL/VSCO match before any split can be called source-disjoint.
Creator self-identifies as Freesound uploader modularsamples, a reserved evaluation uploader.
Already represented in DGE training recipes or protected evaluation partitions; no file-level audit shows unused, unreserved files.

Only lossy MP3 previews are available without sign-in (a codec confound for bitcrush and saturation); 669760 needs upstream patch review; one recording per label cannot support a head or a source-disjoint test.
Known prior IDs or reserved uploader families (exclusion manifest).
